title_zh: RCT：24 節模組化認知行為治療 THOPAS 對 8–12 歲情緒調節困難兒童，整體不優於常規治療
title_en: ADOPT-Treatment RCT: modular CBT (THOPAS) not superior to treatment as usual for affective dysregulation in children
summary_zh: Journal of the American Academy of Child & Adolescent Psychiatry 期刊預印本（2026-11-05 接受）。德國多中心隨機對照試驗，159 名 8–12 歲情緒調節困難兒童，隨機分入 24 節模組化認知行為介入 THOPAS 或常規治療。主要結果（盲評情緒調節困難嚴重度）無組間差異；次要結果僅個別有效；兩組皆有小至中度改善。探索性亞組分析顯示，基線症狀較重者可能較受惠於 THOPAS；研究未有足夠檢定力偵測小效果。
summary_en: Journal pre-proof in the Journal of the American Academy of Child & Adolescent Psychiatry (accepted 5 November 2026). A multicentre randomised controlled trial in Germany with 159 children aged 8-12 with affective dysregulation, randomised to a 24-session modular cognitive-behavioural intervention (THOPAS) or treatment as usual. No between-group differences emerged for the primary outcome (blinded clinician-rated affective dysregulation severity), with only isolated effects on secondary outcomes; both groups showed small-to-moderate improvements over time. Exploratory subgroup analyses suggested children with higher baseline symptom severity may have benefited more from THOPAS; the study was not powered to detect small effects.
evidence_note: 隨機對照試驗（Journal of the American Academy of Child & Adolescent Psychiatry，期刊預印本，2026-11-05 接受；DOI: 10.1016/j.jaac.2026.11.001；尚未定稿）
caution: 期刊預印本，尚未定稿，數字或有修訂；主要結果為陰性，THOPAS 未證實優於高質素常規治療；部分作者申報藥廠相關利益（見原文披露），研究經費來自德國聯邦教育及研究部。

主要結果（盲評嚴重度）無組間差異；次要結果僅個別有效；兩組皆有小至中度改善
基線症狀較重者可能較受惠；研究未有足夠檢定力偵測小效果；THOPAS 可行、治療師忠誠度與家長參與度高
supervision_questions: 一項陰性試驗中，兩組都有改善而介入組未勝出，你會如何向家長解釋「常規治療已經很好」這個訊息？

posts.content: 期刊預印本：24 節模組化認知行為治療 THOPAS 對情緒調節困難兒童的隨機對照試驗，含樣本、介入與主要結果。
